Removing a declared model contribution before a residual operation, then
rejoining its declared contribution, can protect that model path from the
\emph{exactly named} residual operation. It does not establish that the model
is correct, that its content is true sky, or that a mode missing from the
measured path has been observed. The useful scientific question is therefore
which quantity traveled along each path, with what reference, support,
dependence and response, and what claim the combined result can sustain.

The boundary begins at the exact iteration input and state, retaining the
original measured parent. It includes model construction, selection,
acceptance and application, removal, residual processing, bypass, rejoin,
successor state and iteration/terminal identity. It ends at the bundle and
selection record. Downstream inference and use retain separate authorities.
No recurrence, numerical operator or stopping policy is implied by this story.

\begin{description}[style=nextline,leftmargin=0pt,labelwidth=0pt,labelsep=0pt]
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-001: compatible arithmetic]
All additive equalities, differences and cancellations require the full pairwise

with state, support and conditioning fixed as declared. A missing premise
blocks the affected claim; no offset, zero fill or reference alignment is inferred.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-002: fixed residual linearity]
The three-term expansion requires the complete $F_k=A_k$ to be exact fixed
linear on its declared domain and state. A fixed basis or coefficient
recomputation alone establishes neither linearity nor nonlinearity. Affine
offsets must remain in the full procedure when this premise does not hold.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-003: complete fixed linearity]
$A_k,\Pi_k,B_k$ must all be exact fixed linear on declared spaces, units,
support, state and conditioning before defining $D_k$, its linear applied-model
response, or using the four-term covariance identity.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-004: joint conditional covariance]
In addition to ASM-003, use compatible real vector representations, finite
joint second moments and exact $\Om$, including reference/gauge/null-space
coordinates, with applied-model axes and all cross dependence.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-005: response comparison]
The exact query convention, boundaries, baseline/perturbed domains, states,
branches/support and reference/gauge/null-space comparison must be bound.
Derivative existence is a further premise; a finite difference is separately
typed with its own convention. No numerical step is chosen.
\item[SCI-FRUIT-ASM-006: causal continuation]
All future-consequential state and the same compatible future controls/profile
are required for equality with uninterrupted execution. No replay is performed.
\end{description}
